metadata.title: Channels
metadata.description: Channels are a way to manage your app's updates. Each channel can have one version. This allows you to have multiple versions of your app in production at the same time.

Devices stay on their current channel unless you:
Force them to another channel (console or Public API).
Change the cloud override in the dashboard or Public API.
Remove / archive the channel they are on (then they will fall back through the precedence again at next check).

assignment but not a console/API override.

blocks.text: Download format on the channel Information tab. New channels default to Zip + delta.
This setting chooses what Capgo sends when a device on this channel checks for an update. Leave
unless you need to force one type.

Each device gets the best package it supports. Devices on a plugin version with Delta support download only the changed delta files when the bundle has them. Only devices on an old plugin version without Delta support, or bundles uploaded without delta files, fall back to the full zip.
Every device downloads the whole bundle zip, even when delta files exist.
Only the changed delta files. Devices on an old plugin version without Delta support still receive the full zip when the bundle has one.
Full zip from store build only
Full zip only while the device is still on the store build. After the first live update, Capgo serves zip + delta again.
Delta only while the device is still on the store build. After the first live update, Capgo serves zip + delta again.

You can set the same value from the CLI. The channel must already exist:
npx @capgo/cli@latest channel set production com.example.app --update-package zip
